headlines.text: Flash back to 2021, when Mike Sydal touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.72.
Flash back to 2023, when the AEW World Trios Titles was up for grabs as The Elite vs. Top Flight & Fox went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.92. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Turning the clock back to 2021: The Young Bucks vs. Proud-N-Powerful fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.24 ? a match that delivered. Proud-N-Powerful was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Archer, Fenix & Moxley wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.16 ? a well-worked match.
2023 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Dustin Rhodes and Swerve Strickland, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 7.12 ? a solid showing.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Riho vs. Serena Deeb met in a Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 7.61 ? a good, competitive contest.
